Public reference for the three Live View operation identifiers in
src/phase0/experimental/wpd_live_view_codec.cpp:
https://github.com/dukus/digiCamControl/blob/a95ee52bbc1e192a7d1da038f3af6561b185d312/CameraControl.Devices/Nikon/NikonBase.cs
Upstream file SHA-256: 4328ec2fb6f31fc4b1cd04d643d2dd8aa2e7ade72c9bd4f37a083e9b0975abbc

No upstream driver class, retry loop, settings/capture/card implementation,
or SDK material is included. The WPD message codec is written for this repository.
The D810 preview's 384-byte JPEG prefix offset also references NikonD600Base.cs
at the same fixed commit (D810 -> D600 -> D600Base inheritance):
https://github.com/dukus/digiCamControl/blob/a95ee52bbc1e192a7d1da038f3af6561b185d312/CameraControl.Devices/Nikon/NikonD600Base.cs
Read-only Live View status/prohibition/focus-mode identifiers 0xD1A2/0xD1A4/0xD061
also reference NikonBase.cs at that commit. No upstream implementation is copied.
AF-only 0x90C1, manual-focus-drive 0x9204 (direction 1 near / 2 far),
the small step value 10, and readiness query 0x90C8 also reference NikonBase.cs
at that fixed commit. The bounded mailbox/readiness/UI implementation is new.
The development still-capture codec also references the public no-AF SDRAM
capture 0x90C0 / 0xFFFFFFFF, GetEvent 0x90C7 and Nikon event framing/codes,
CompressionSetting 0x5004 and ImageSize 0x5003 in NikonBase.cs, and the standard
GetObjectInfo/GetObject identifiers and ObjectInfo fields in BaseMTPCamera.cs
at the same fixed commit. No upstream capture/retry loop or settings writer
is copied. The single-use shutter, strict attribution, partial retention and
verified PC persistence workflow are implemented for this repository.
The upstream copyright and MIT license follow.
The development level display uses only the public numeric facts for signed
big-endian roll/pitch integer words at payload offsets 52/56 in NikonD600Base.cs,
BaseMTPCamera.ToInt16, and degree-based RotateTransform in LiveViewWnd.xaml
at the same fixed commit. No fractional encoding or sensor validity is inferred.
https://github.com/dukus/digiCamControl/blob/a95ee52bbc1e192a7d1da038f3af6561b185d312/CameraControl.Devices/BaseMTPCamera.cs
https://github.com/dukus/digiCamControl/blob/a95ee52bbc1e192a7d1da038f3af6561b185d312/CameraControl/windows/LiveViewWnd.xaml
